blocks.p: This query first sets a variable query_now (though it's not strictly used in the subsequent steps), then filters the Syslog_CL table to only include logs where the host name (host_s) exactly matches 'app-02'. Finally, it projects (selects) only the timestamp, host name, and the log message.
blocks.tip: This is the most common use case for log queries—isolating all log messages from a single, critical application server (app-02) to diagnose a recent issue, check for configuration changes, or review activity during a specific time period.
blocks.tipLabel: Why it matters: Troubleshooting & Focused Investigation
blocks.code:
set query_now = datetime(2025-10-30T05:09:25.9886229Z);
Syslog_CL
| where host_s == 'app-02'
| project _timestamp_t, host_s, Message
